tldr: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned effective immediately on 12 Nov amid a scandal involving an alleged affair with a suspected Chinese intelligence operative -- NVDA fell ~4-10% intraday, dragging SMH/XLK, even as AMD and Broadcom rallied on rotation; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO, and Nvidia's 17 Nov earnings call is now a binary catalyst for the whole AI-capex trade.

The Fed's hawkish pivot is now confirmed by data, not just Fed-speak: October core CPI printed +0.3% m/m for a third straight month (vs +0.2% forecast), pushing CME-implied odds of a December hike to 100% (~87% 25bp / ~13% 50bp); the 10Y yield spiked to 5.107% and DXY hit a ~19-month high (~103.17).

Gold/silver/miners extended their real-yield-driven rout into a third straight session (GLD -2.8% to $354.89, gold cracking below $3,900-equivalent) -- separately, the code-owned risk calc shows the silver loan's stressed margin-call distance has compressed to 10.4% (from 13.2% yesterday), context worth keeping in view, not a new finding from today's research.

China's MOFCOM confirmed on 9 Nov it extended -- not let lapse -- the rare-earth/battery export-control suspension through 10 Jan 2027, correcting yesterday's 'truce expired' read and cooling the near-term scarcity catalyst for the ex-China rare-earth basket (MP, Lynas, Energy Fuels, USAR all pulled back on the news).

Cross-market flows are narrow rather than broad risk-on: Hong Kong's Southbound mainland money bought for a 4th straight session (Alibaba, Zhipu AI, SMIC) even through Thursday's down close, and Korean foreign institutions bought for a 3rd straight day against retail and now domestic-institutional selling -- a stock/theme-specific bid, not a uniform regional one.

topNews.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns effective immediately amid spy-affair scandal; CFO Colette Kress interim CEO
